items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: people tell me, just like Alberta Hunter, 'you know, you aint bitchyenough'.

ctx.x: In fact, you haven't told us about, and we haven't come to that yet and we're going to talk about that, '73 on. But one thing we ought to say about it is, it's not only that you made a comeback and were bigger in your career than ever before but it was different, I think, wasn't it? It is like your horizons were broadened. I mean, for a time like in the late '40s and early '50s when R. and B. was big and you did "Ebobaleeba" and you did "Million Dollar Secret". You were a big star like other stars then. But it…

Yeah, well you know people tell me, just like Alberta Hunter, "you know, you aint bitchyenough". I said, "what?" She said, "you aint bitchy enough". I said, "well, what do I have to do?" She said, "you just ought to lay everybody out and let them know you're this and you're that and you're the other". I said, "Oh shucks, if they don't know what I am I don't know what to tell them, and if I've got to be bitchy then I'll just forget about the singing".
